'''Diner Port''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]]. It was located near the [[Carannia Spaceport/Legends|Serenno Spaceport]], and was decorated with a red [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] marquee.<ref name="AotE:HT4" />
